references: In information systems design and enterprise architecture, a single source of truth (SSOT) is the practice of structuring data models and associated architecture such that every data element is mastered in a single location. Any possible references to this data element are made by link rather than duplication. By preventing redundant data storage across multiple spreadsheets or isolated databases, organizations ensure data consistency, streamline reporting, and provide reliable inputs for analytical and artificial intelligence applications.
